question: The maximum urinary excretion of a drug refers to:

options.opa: The maximum concentration of unchanged drug in urine.
options.opb: The maximum speed at which the drug can be excreted unchanged by urine.
options.opc: The amount of urine collected after 7 biological half-lives after the administration of the drug.
options.opd: The total amount of drug that is excreted unaltered in urine after the administration of a certain dose.
options.ope: The amount of unchanged drug recovered in urine at 24 hours after the administration of a certain dose.
